cohort: 11,951 individuals in midwifery-led care birthing at either OHSU from 2012 to 2019 or UMHS from 2007 to 2019
finding: While overall cesarean rates were low in midwifery-led care, individuals of advanced maternal age (AMA) had higher rates compared to younger counterparts, with Robson TGCS group 5 (multiparous with previous cesarean) being the primary contributor.
mod_finding: Prelabor cesarean and induced labor partly mediated the relationship between AMA and cesarean among nulliparous individuals, whereas prelabor cesarean was the key contributor to cesarean among multiparous people.
